secrets.name: NEXTAUTH_SECRET
secrets.description: Auth.js (next-auth v5) session/signing secret, at least 32 characters. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`. A development placeholder is supplied so the app boots.

secrets.name: YOUTUBE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional YouTube Data API key for server-side embeddability checks. Not wired yet; the app works without it.
